summary: The audit trail is protected and names the real person behind every change.

new.title: Audit retention
new.text: The Audit page shows how long rows are kept. By default every row is kept; a SuperAdmin can set a period of 13 months or more.

new.title: Delegated administrators see their audit
new.text: Delegated administrators can now open Audit and see their own actions and events about what they own.

new.title: Three more safety alerts
new.text: You are alerted when definitions disappear while live items remain, when a Pro licence no longer covers MSP, and when drift exceeds the removal budget.

new.title: Request portal easy to find
new.text: The menu has Access requests (RFA portal) and Consultants & companies, with the portal link and a Copy button.

fixes.title: The audit trail cannot be edited
fixes.text: Audit rows are protected from change, even outside PIM Manager. Rows only leave through the retention you set.

fixes.title: Audit names the real person
fixes.text: Changes the engine makes for someone's commit now name that person and the approver, not "engine".

fixes.title: Licence and updates from Invardia on by default
fixes.text: Requesting the licence and Pro updates from Invardia are now on by default. Switch them off under Settings > Features.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: More numbers follow your number format.
